title: Parallel Subagent Page Expansion
subtitle: 53 pages added lobby links via 4 parallel subagents reading and matching styles
key_concept: Scalable, style-aware page injection through parallel agents
visual_metaphor: Four architectural arches rising simultaneously, each supporting a row of 13 identical stone blocks
highlights: 8 pages already had lobby links; 53 new pages added
Each subagent read file first to match existing style (button groups, headers, or fixed-position fallback)
why_it_matters: Demonstrates pattern for large-scale, context-sensitive updates across the cathedral
zone_change: Expanded lobby link coverage from 8 to 61 pages, crossing into new sections
